headline.text: L1 S2 allergen cleaning verification failed *3 times* on C1 belt before passing; White Z belt and jar area signed off but not cleaned; product on wrong pallets now on hold pending rework.

summary: Three active issues at L1: metal screw caught by X-ray on S1 (source identified, replaced), product on wrong pallets held for rework on S2, and multiple sanitation sign-off failures on S2 — C1 belt failed allergen 3× before passing, White Z belt and jar area marked clean but found with residue.

holds.title: S2 product on wrong pallets, held for rework
holds.summary: Product packed on US PECO pallets instead of Mexico PECO-HT pallets per spec; QA tagging each pallet as rework, product must not leave plant pending pallet swap.
holds.status: Open — QA tagging pallets one by one, warehouse searching for correct pallets, new order placed.

food_safety.title: Metal screw found in S1 bag via X-ray
food_safety.summary: X-ray rejected bag containing metal screw at 16:25; believed from Eaglestone conveyor, screw replaced, follow-up X-ray validation tests all passed.
food_safety.status: Resolved — screw source identified and replaced, X-ray verified rejecting correctly.

quality.title: VFFS box label not scanned, found in trash
quality.summary: Inventory check found one box label in trash that was never entered into system; line lead to be coached Monday.
quality.status: Resolved — label recovered, line lead follow-up scheduled for Monday.

sanitation.title: S2 C1 belt allergen test failed 3 times before passing
sanitation.summary: C1 belt signed off and marked green by 3rd shift but never passed allergen test; failed at 09:41, 10:30, and 11:26 before passing on 4th attempt at 11:50.
sanitation.status: Resolved on 4th test — C1 passed allergen at 11:50, management meeting requested on sign-off process.

sanitation.title: S2 White Z belt signed off but not cleaned
sanitation.summary: White Z belt crossed out on paperwork but found with chocolate residue and a piece of chocolate in framework; cleaned during 1st shift startup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — belt cleaned and inspected, passed pre-ops before startup.

sanitation.title: S3 jar area marked clean but not cleaned
sanitation.summary: Jar area marked green on level 4 clean but found not cleaned from last shift; cleaned during 1st shift startup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — jar area cleaned during 1st shift, shifting focus to jar area over MMs for next week.

sanitation.title: S2 C2/C3 belts could not validate cleaning
sanitation.summary: C2 and C3 belts not signed off by QA on 3rd shift; could not validate allergen testing was done, re-cleaned and tested during 1st shift.
sanitation.status: Resolved — C2 and C3 re-cleaned, passed allergen testing, ready to run.

sanitation.title: S2 cleaning book documentation gaps
sanitation.summary: Multiple pages crossed out on cleaning paperwork with no notes or validation; QA asked to review book to ensure no blanks.
sanitation.status: Investigation ongoing — Charity Young requested QA review of cleaning book.

opportunities.text: Consider adding a QA counter-signature requirement before marking equipment 'green' on cleaning checklists — based on 4 incidents today (C1, C2, C3 belts, White Z belt, S3 jar area) where production signed off equipment that had not passed or been tested.
Review labeling and segregation of specialty pallets (PECO-HT Mexico vs US) — based on wrong pallets used on S2, now 300 pallets missing and product on rework hold.
